values.note: $12 a night non-electric, $12.15 primitive: the Indiana DNR first-come rate for state forests off the reservation system. Vehicle entrance $7 Indiana, $15 out of state, mid-May through October. Rates will likely change once the electric renovation finishes. Read 2026-10-31.

fees.source: https://www.in.gov/dnr/state-parks/rates-and-fees/camping-fees (First-Come, First-Served Camping: Non-Electric $12, Primitive $12.15) and https://www.in.gov/dnr/forestry/properties/ferdinand-state-forest/ (entrance), read 2026-10-31

facilities.source: https://www.in.gov/dnr/forestry/properties/ferdinand-state-forest/ ('Vault toilets and seasonal drinking water'), read 2026-10-31

note: Indiana DNR Division of Forestry, Ferdinand State Forest family campground. Under renovation (DNR alert read 2026-10-31): contractors are adding pads, electricity at each site, a comfort station and water points, finishing late 2026 or early 2027; some of the campground stays open at first, but at some point all of it will close. Main road into the forest closed two to three months from about Oct. 5 for culverts, access by gravel road off County Road E 700 South. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 57 sites, FCFS, $12/$12.15; added $7/$15 entrance, vault toilets, seasonal water. Renovation and road closure dated in note; old 'loops A & B' text removed as wrong. STATUS flag.
flags: STATUS, your call: DNR alert 'at some point, the entire campground will be closed... expected to be completed in late 2026 or early 2027', with no closing date. Partly open as of the alert, so no status written (a partial closure is a note). Re-check; if closed, set temporarily_closed with reopens 'late 2026 or early 2027'. After that, hookups, showers and fees will all change.

ROAD: 'Beginning on or shortly after Oct. 5, the main road into Ferdinand State Forest will close for two large culvert replacements... two to three months', access via a gravel road off County Road E 700 South. Rig fit of that gravel road not stated.

NOTE CORRECTION: old note said loops A and B sit on the lake's north shore and C-E are set back. DNR's trail map labels A-E as picnic SHELTERS (Maple, Tulip, Pine, CCC, Sycamore); it marks campground symbols north of the road toward Fossil Lake, south of the lake's east end near the boat launch, and at the far southeast. Removed. Stored 'not waterfront' stands: the clearing at the pin is about 500 m+ from Ferdinand Lake. The southern symbol near the launch is a weak water lead, under canopy, not proven.
LAKE: 'Ferdinand Lake has been lowered... expected to return to its normal level in mid-March 2027.'
FIT: page does not give lengths; camping pads are being rebuilt. No criteria issue seen.
